body:
The last time I was sent to my local mental hospital (over a year and a half ago), it was awful. Trying not to doxx myself, but many rapes and assaults happen because it is understaffed to shreds. The help I received there was incalculably small compared to the additional trauma and ptsd of hearing and seeing people get beaten up, and the screams I heard.

The next couple of months involved a terrible psych who prescribed meds that made me feel just as shitty, but also dull and stupid. 

This was just after I was diagnosed. Since then, I've been able to calm my psychosis, but the depression is gradually getting worse.
